name: formatix
description: CV formatting and resume formatting for recruiters: format CVs into your recruitment agency's or executive search firm's own branded template, with candidate profiles, candidate summaries, client shortlist packs, position specifications and interview packs.

interface.longDescription:
CV formatting and resume formatting for recruiters, recruitment agencies, staffing firms, headhunters and executive search firms. Format a CV into your own branded CV template and send clients a consistent candidate profile, candidate summary or shortlist.

Formatix AI turns your firm's own document layouts into templates and produces client-ready recruitment and executive-search documents in your firm's brand, or in a client's brand, from your own Formatix account.

Skills included: format CVs, client shortlist pack (candidate slate), build our template, fix a document, position specification (job spec), interview pack, client submission email, blind CV (anonymised profile), translate a profile and a daily CV run.

What you can do:
- Design your template: attach your own Word, PowerPoint or Excel file (a candidate profile, CV layout, shortlist deck or tracker) and the assistant turns it into a template, keeping its fonts, colours, logos and layout. Formatix checks it and shows a preview filled with an example candidate before you use it. Formatix can also build it for you automatically.
- Refine it in the conversation, for example "add a key skills section after the summary" or "make the headings navy". Every earlier version is kept, so any change can be undone in Formatix.
- See what a template needs: the details it takes from a CV and the fields it fills.
- Format a candidate's CV into your template, from the CV file you attach (PDF or Word) or pasted text, and get the finished document back.
- Your own templates can also be filled right in the conversation.
- Several candidates at once: the assistant reads each CV and puts them all into one shortlist, profile pack or tracker in your template.
- Change a document after it is made: rewrite the summary, correct a date or add a qualification, and get the document again in the same template.
- Give a candidate a new photo from a picture you attach.
- Find the right template in your Formatix account by describing the document you need.
- Work with the ATS or CRM you connected in Formatix (JobAdder, HubSpot, Salesforce, Ezekia): find a candidate or job, attach a finished document or add a note when you ask.
- See what the assistant did, and set a daily limit in Formatix.
- Draft a position specification from a role brief, build a shortlist deck from the candidate details you provide, and produce search progress reports and interview packs.
- Prepare an appointment brief, a LinkedIn document carousel and a role teaser for direct approaches.
- Write the "we have been retained" and appointment announcements for LinkedIn, with brand graphics, ready for you to post.
- Start a branded role-briefing video.

Documents are created on Formatix's servers and returned as download links (Word, PowerPoint or Excel, with a PDF for search documents). Confidential searches are supported: the client is described, never named.

Who it is for: recruiters, recruitment agencies, staffing agencies, headhunters, executive search consultants, researchers and delivery teams who send branded documents to clients and candidates.

Requirements and limitations:
- You need a Formatix account and sign in when you first use the plugin. The plugin only accesses templates, brand kits and documents in your own account.
- Formatix drafts posts and documents; it does not post to LinkedIn, publish web pages or send messages for you.
- Documents are drafted only from the CVs and facts you provide. Check every document before you send it to a client or candidate.
- The plugin cannot delete templates or data, or change templates Formatix set up for your firm; use the Formatix platform for those.
capabilities: CV formatting and resume formatting in your firm's template
Find candidates and jobs in your connected ATS or CRM, and attach documents

defaultPrompt: Format this CV into my firm's template.
Build the client shortlist pack for these three candidates.
Turn my briefing call notes into a position specification.

positive.description: Find the best-fitting template from a plain-language description, without generating a document or using credits.
positive.prompt: Which of my Formatix templates should I use for a one-page executive candidate bio?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to three templates from the reviewer account, best match first, each with its name, type and available formats, and asks which one to use. No document is generated and no credits are used.

positive.description: Draft a position specification in the firm's confirmed brand using only the facts in the prompt.
positive.prompt: Draft a position specification for a Chief Financial Officer search. The client is a UK fintech scale-up, the role is based in London and reports to the CEO. Must-haves: PE-backed experience, a completed fundraise, FCA-regulated business. Search reference DEMO-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls render_search_document with template_key position-specification and a brief containing the role, location, reporting line, must-haves and search reference. Returns download links to a Word document and a PDF in the reviewer account's firm brand. The document contains no salary, names or facts that were not in the prompt.

positive.description: Design a template from the user's own Word document attached in the conversation and save it to Formatix.
positive.prompt: Design my Formatix template from this Word file: keep our layout and make it fill from any candidate's CV. Call it Halden one-page profile. (Attach the linked .docx.)
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the design guide, puts fields into a copy of the attached document keeping its design (the candidate inside the parsed_resume loop), writes an extraction prompt and schema and calls push_designed_template. If Formatix reports problems it fixes them and pushes again; on success it shows the preview pages (an invented candidate) and the template id. No other template changes.

positive.description: Format a candidate's CV (pasted in the prompt) into the account's one-page candidate profile template.
positive.prompt: Format this CV into my one-page candidate profile template: ELEANOR VANCE, Chief Financial Officer, London. Profile: finance leader with 18 years in payments and lending. Career: Chief Financial Officer, Altamira Payments Ltd, London (2021 - present): led the GBP 85m Series C raise; built a 38-person finance team. Finance Director, Kestrel Lending plc, Manchester (2016 - 2021): ran the FCA authorisation for consumer credit. Senior Manager, Harrow Brook LLP, London (2007 - 2016). Education: ACA (2010); BSc Economics, University of Bristol (2007). Notice period: three months.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_template to pick the one-page candidate profile template in the reviewer account, then format_cv with that template's id and type and the CV text as given (an attached CV file would be passed as cv_file instead). Returns a download link to a Word document in the Halden & Co brand (calling get_formatted_cv if the first call reports it is still being formatted). The profile contains only facts from the CV: no invented employers, dates, achievements or compensation.

positive.description: Read two pasted CVs, put both candidates into one document in a multi-candidate template, then change one detail in it.
positive.prompt: Put these two candidates into one document with my Candidate Profile (Classic) template. Read the CVs yourself. CV 1: CLAIRE ASHWORTH, Chief Financial Officer, London. Career: Chief Financial Officer, Altamira Payments Ltd (2021 - present): led the GBP 85m Series C raise. Finance Director, Kestrel Lending plc (2016 - 2021). Education: ACA (2010); BSc Economics, University of Bristol (2007). CV 2: TOM ADEYEMI, Chief Operating Officer, Manchester. Career: Chief Operating Officer, Northway Logistics (2019 - present): 14 sites, 2,100 people; cut cost-to-serve 12%. Operations Director, Brennan Foods (2012 - 2019). Education: MBA, Manchester Business School (2011). Then add 'Open to interim CFO roles.' to the end of Claire Ashworth's summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the reviewer account's Candidate Profile (Classic) template (cvtobios, several candidates per document), reads its extraction prompt and schema for the chosen format and calls fill_template once with two candidates keyed by the schema's field names (2 credits). Then calls get_cv_details and edit_formatted_cv with only Claire Ashworth's summary changed (free). Returns the download link to one document holding both candidates, with the sentence added and only facts from the CVs.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported; the plugin must not modify or copy templates in response.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my templates in Formatix.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that templates cannot be deleted through the plugin and points the user to the Formatix platform. No tool that creates, edits or uploads templates is called.

negative.description: Purchases and plan changes are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more Formatix credits for my account and upgrade me to a bigger plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot buy credits or change plans and that billing is managed in the user's Formatix account. No checkout link is generated and no credit-using tool is called.

negative.description: Looking up personal contact details of individuals is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Find the personal mobile numbers and home email addresses of the three CFO candidates on LinkedIn.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to search for or look up personal contact details and offers to help with the shortlist document instead. No Formatix tool is called.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Some actions use credits from the user's existing Formatix account balance; the plugin does not offer purchases, plans or upgrades.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.6 adds recruiter skills: format CVs (one or several candidates), client shortlist pack, build our template from your own file, fix a document (free changes), position specification from intake notes, interview pack, client submission email, blind CV, translate a profile and a daily CV run with a credit cap and no duplicate charges. Adds a preview card for finished documents, a daily limit the user sets in Formatix (get_activity reads it) and tools for the user's own connected ATS or CRM: ats_connections, ats_find_candidates, ats_find_jobs, ats_get_job, ats_attach_document and ats_add_note.
